technical.summary: Mixed technicals with long-term trend support (EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish) but weak near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, negative MACD, price below key MAs) and no active strategy triggers—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 14 days adds timing risk with no fundamental tailwinds to support entry.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (30/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (97+ days old) with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (401.76), flat yield curve, imminent NFP event, and earnings in 14 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 bullish alignment with price near support (293.99) in extreme fear environment (VIX 401.76) offers contrarian entry for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, negative MACD, price below all key MAs), zero strategy triggers, imminent earnings in 14 days, crisis macro backdrop (VIX spike, flat yield curve, NFP event), and no institutional/insider conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support (293.99) and long-term EMA/SMA 50/200 are bullish, weak near-term momentum (RSI sub-50, negative MACD, price below all key MAs) combined with zero strategy triggers and imminent earnings (14 days) create insufficient confluence for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 14 days with crisis macro backdrop (VIX 401.76, flat yield curve, NFP event) creates binary event risk that invalidates swing trade thesis before technical setup can develop.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; debate winner decisively bear (8 vs 3)
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 3 other IT holdings in 31-position portfolio argues against adding exposure; sector concentration and ticker overlap reduce conviction further.
